summary: Completed testing of Match Score Integration and Auto-Suggest Schools features. All 7 requested features verified working correctly: GET /api/match-scores returns scores with program_id, university_name, match_score, match_reasons; GET /api/suggested-schools returns suggestions excluding pipeline programs; Pipeline page shows color-coded match score badges (green 80%+, amber 60-79%, gray <60%); Journey page header shows Match badge with Target icon; Schools page has 'Recommended for You' section with suggestion cards; Add to Board button adds school to pipeline and removes from suggestions.
passed_tests: GET /api/match-scores returns 200 with scores array containing program_id, university_name, match_score, match_reasons
GET /api/match-scores scores are integers 0-100 and sorted descending
GET /api/suggested-schools returns 200 with suggestions array containing university_name, match_score, match_reasons, division
GET /api/suggested-schools excludes schools already in pipeline
GET /api/suggested-schools returns max 12 results sorted by score
Pipeline page displays match score badges next to university names (data-testid: match-score-{program_id})
Pipeline badges use correct colors: green (emerald) for 80%+, amber for 60-79%, gray for <60%
Journey page header shows Match badge with percentage and Target icon (data-testid: journey-match-score)
Journey badge color matches score: 90% = green, 61% = amber
Schools page shows 'Recommended for You' section (data-testid: suggested-schools-section)
Suggestion cards display match score percentage, division badge, match reasons (e.g., Division Match, Preferred Region)
Suggestion cards have 'Add to Board' buttons (data-testid: suggest-add-{university-name-kebab})
Clicking 'Add to Board' shows success toast and removes card from suggestions
Added school appears in pipeline programs list
critical_code_review_comments: Match score calculation logic in athlete_profile.py is well-structured with proper weighting for division (30pts), region (25pts), priorities (30pts), and school size (15pts)
Color coding correctly implemented in frontend: emerald/green (80%+), amber (60-79%), gray (<60%)
Suggested schools endpoint properly filters out existing pipeline programs
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing: match-score-{id}, journey-match-score, suggested-schools-section, suggest-add-{name}
seed_data_creation: Used existing data - added University of Nebraska-Kearney to pipeline during Add to Board test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Match Score Integration and Auto-Suggest Schools features fully tested. Match scores are calculated based on athlete profile (division, regions, priorities, school_size) stored in athlete_profiles collection. Suggested schools are filtered from university_knowledge_base collection, excluding programs already in pipeline. Test data includes program with 90% match (Concordia-St. Paul), 61% (Creighton), 44% (Baylor), etc. to verify color coding.
